rows.text: calls through the pointer at `008C2798` with `rcx`, stores the address `00900F20` at qword `+0` of `rcx`, zeroes qword `+0x68` and stores at dword `+0x70` a mask built from `edx`: 4 when `edx` bit 0 is clear, plus 2 when bit 1 is clear, plus 8 when bit 3 is set, plus 0x10 when bit 2 is set; returns `rcx`
calls `001E0100` with `rcx` + 8, the incoming `rdx`, `r8` and `r9`, and 0 as the fifth (stack) argument, then returns the incoming `rdx`
